2. Free app and one-time purchase "The Collection"

The App is free to download. Four games (Klondike, Mahjong solitaire, Ensō and Pyramid), the garden and the firefly walk can be used without limit and without any purchase.

A single, non-consumable in-app purchase, "The Collection", unlocks the App's other games and the fireworks activity, as included in the version you are using; it also gives you a kintsugi vase for the garden and makes the care plant bloom faster. It involves no subscription and no recurring fee. Its price is the one displayed by the App Store at the time of purchase, in your currency.

  • Purchase, billing and refunds are handled by Apple under the Apple Media Services Terms and Conditions. We have no access to any payment data. The applicable right of withdrawal is the one provided by those terms, as Apple sells the in-app purchase in its own name; for digital content supplied immediately, it may end as soon as supply begins if you have expressly consented to this (Article L.221-28, 13° of the Code de la consommation (French Consumer Code)).
  • The purchase is linked to your Apple Account. You can restore it at any time from within the App (offer screen or settings), for example after reinstalling or on another device.
  • When Family Sharing is enabled, the purchase may be shared with the members of your Family Sharing group in accordance with Apple's rules.
  • A purchase refunded by Apple no longer unlocks the games and the fireworks; items already in your garden, including the gifted vase, are kept.
  • If you are a minor, ask a parent or guardian for permission before making any in-app purchase. Parents can block in-app purchases with Screen Time, or require their approval with the "Ask to Buy" feature of Apple's Family Sharing.

Some rounds of paid games may be offered free of charge (trial round, free game of the day, round offered by a flower in the garden). These gestures are made at our discretion and do not constitute a purchase.

The App contains no advertising and sells no virtual currency. Petals earned by playing have no monetary value, cannot be purchased, and can be neither converted into money, nor transferred to another player, nor refunded; they are used only to obtain items in the game.

3. Offline use and saved progress

The App works without a connection and without an account. Your progress is saved on your device and, if you are signed in to iCloud, in your iCloud, so that you can pick it up on your other devices. When two devices have progressed separately, the save with the most wins (or, if tied, the most rounds played) is kept in full and replaces the other. We are not responsible for loss of progress caused by deleting the App, signing out of iCloud, changing Apple Account, or the failure of your device or of a third-party service, unless it results from a defect in the App.

4. Daily reminder

After a few wins, the App asks you once, through the iOS prompt, whether you would like a daily reminder. This is a local notification, scheduled on your device at the time of your last visit, at most once a day, and sent only if you have allowed it. You can turn it off at any time in iOS Settings.

The App requires an iPhone or iPad running iOS or iPadOS 16 or later. It may not function correctly on unsupported devices. We are not responsible for the App's unavailability or degraded behavior on such devices.
